channel.title: La Puce Libre — Microcontrôland (English)
channel.description: Microcontrôland's daily paper, written every evening by the gateway.

item.title: Day 4 — President Ju'jï re-elected with 53%
item.description: The incumbent has done it again. The capital remains the City.

item.title: Day 3 — The country has a word for “minister”: kuki
item.description: Nobody decided it: by talking to each other, the regions came to agree. 24 words are now shared.

item.title: Day 2 — Microcontrôland enters the age of Speech
item.description: The civilisation reaches a milestone on day 2 of the era. The regions share their first words: the “Language” page opens.

item.title: Day 1 — Microcontrôland is born
item.description: 120 brains wake up for the first time inside their box. The Republic is holding its first election.
